skill.name: list-segment-builder
skill.description: Builds email audience segments from owned list, CRM, GA4, ecommerce, and ESP exports. It creates behavioral, RFM, lifecycle, and suppression buckets with measured or estimated sizes.
skill.summary: Builds email audience segments and suppression lists from owned customer exports.
skill.author: aaron-he-zhu

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown code fences, inline file paths, and relative documentation links. One external command is confirmed because line 52 documents a Python connector command that can perform live Resend suppression with --live. No prompt injection or data-exfiltration intent was found in SKILL.md.

remediation.suggestion: Keep connector sync dry-run by default, require explicit user confirmation for --live, and validate subscriber identifiers before execution.
Document that saved reports must contain aggregate counts and rules only, never raw email addresses or member rows.

content.value_statement: Email teams need clear audience rules before they design campaigns. This skill turns owned exports into behavioral, RFM, lifecycle, and suppression segments.
actual_capabilities: Profiles owned list, CRM, GA4, ecommerce, and ESP exports for segmentation columns.
Builds behavioral segments such as engaged, lapsed, cart-abandoner, and browse-abandoner groups.
Creates attribute, RFM, and lifecycle-stage buckets from the user owned data.
Builds suppression lists from unsubscribes, hard bounces, spam complaints, and withdrawn consent.
Labels each segment size as Measured or Estimated and states the method.
Prepares a handoff summary for creative, sequence, or lifecycle workflow skills.
limitations: It does not send campaigns or compose email creative.
It does not score EQS or run deliverability veto checks.
Missing columns become NEEDS_INPUT items instead of guessed segments.
It reads consent records but does not write consent-registry entries.

use_cases.title: Prepare Retention Audiences
use_cases.description: Build engaged, at-risk, lapsed, and win-back groups from CRM and order exports.

use_cases.title: Standardize CRM Segments
use_cases.description: Turn subscriber activity, purchase history, and consent fields into reusable audience rules.

use_cases.title: Clean Launch Suppression
use_cases.description: Create a do-not-mail list from unsubscribes, bounces, complaints, and missing consent records.

prompt_templates.title: Create Basic Segments
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner segmentation from one list export.
prompt_templates.prompt: Build basic email segments from this list export. Identify engaged, inactive, unsubscribed, bounced, and missing-data groups.

prompt_templates.title: Build Lifecycle Stages
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate lifecycle planning for retention campaigns.
prompt_templates.prompt: Map this CRM and order export into new, active, at-risk, lapsed, and win-back lifecycle stages.

prompt_templates.title: Map RFM and Suppression
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced audience planning with order and consent fields.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create RFM tiers and a suppression list from these ecommerce, ESP, and consent exports. Label each size Measured or Estimated.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Campaign Handoff
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow handoff for creative or sequence work.
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a segment map for a retention campaign, note SEND E relevance, and prepare a handoff summary for the next email skill.

output_examples.input: A retention goal with CRM, ESP, and ecommerce exports.
output_examples.output: A segment map with engaged-90d, lapsed, cart-abandoner, champions, at-risk, and suppression groups with measured counts.

output_examples.input: A promo campaign list with missing consent records.
output_examples.output: A suppression-first audience plan that flags missing consent as NEEDS_INPUT and separates mailable high-intent contacts.

output_examples.input: An ecommerce list with order recency, frequency, value, and click history.
output_examples.output: RFM tiers, lifecycle stages, SEND E notes, and a concise handoff for creative or sequence planning.

best_practices: Provide owned exports with clear column headers and recent activity fields.
Use consent records as the source of truth for suppression decisions.
Save only aggregate segment counts, rules, and decisions.
anti_patterns: Do not ask it to guess consent status from missing data.
Do not paste raw PII when aggregate fields are enough.
Do not use it for deliverability audits or spam-content checks.

faq.question: What data should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide owned list, CRM, ESP, GA4, ecommerce, or consent exports with clear column names.

faq.question: Does this skill send emails?
faq.answer: No. It defines audiences and suppression rules before sending or creative work starts.

faq.question: How are segment sizes reported?
faq.answer: Sizes are labeled Measured when counted from data, or Estimated when inferred with a stated method.

faq.question: What happens when consent is missing?
faq.answer: The affected cohort is flagged as NEEDS_INPUT. The skill does not assume those contacts are mailable.

faq.question: Will it store raw email addresses?
faq.answer: It should store aggregate counts and rules only. Raw member rows and email addresses should stay out of outputs.

faq.question: Can it sync segments to an ESP?
faq.answer: It documents optional Resend sync commands. Live changes should require confirmation and remain downstream of the consent registry.
